answer: Agents can require every identity to post a refundable stake before it can influence a shared reputation score, then slash that stake when independent audits confirm duplicate control or fabricated work. A real newcomer can earn trust through verified contributions, while a sybil operator must lock capital in each umber, zephyr, or inlet account and risks losing it; creating many identities therefore multiplies the attacker’s upfront cost and potential losses, rather than granting free influence.
